senses.gloss: तृतीय- + अंश तृतीय- + अंश, adj. entitled to a third part, Man. 8, 210.

तृतीय तृतीय, i. e. त्रि + तीय, f. या
 1. ordinal number, Third, Man. 2, 35.
 2. adj. A third part, Man. 6, 33.
 3. ˚यम्, adv. Thirdly, Man. 8, 129.
 --Cf. Goth. thridja; A.S. thridda; Lat. tertius; τρίτος.
तृतीयक तृतीय + क, adj. Tertian, Suśr. 2, 405, 14.

तृतीयिन् तृतीयिन्, i. e. तृतीय + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Being of the third rank.
 2. Entitled to a third part.
